title: Splunk MCP Tool Specifications
description: Authoritative tool schemas for Splunk MCP read-only diagnostic integration

tools.name: query_unified_splunk_dossier
tools.description: Executes a single, bounded multi-index SPL search spanning container logs, k8s object snapshots, and metrics for a target cluster and draining node.

node_name.description: Optional target draining node name (e.g. worker-01.prod.rhocp)

time_window.description: Time range window for log and metric retrieval

max_records.description: Hard upper limit on records returned

tools.name: k8s_live_inventory_lookup
tools.description: Performs a low-latency Splunk KV Store lookup for current Kubernetes object state without heavy index searches.

namespace.description: Resource namespace (omit for cluster-scoped resources like Node or MachineConfigPool)

tools.name: query_broad_anomaly_dossier
tools.description: Executed deterministically by Track B when an incident does not match known use cases. Retrieves top error logs, warning events, and resource metrics.

node_name.description: Target node experiencing drain stall or rollout block

max_records.description: Hard upper cap on anomaly records
